issues.detail: The Greek verb 'ευρισκει' (he found) is in the indicative active, but the Vietnamese translation uses 'gặp' (met), which implies a mutual meeting rather than the act of finding/locating someone.
The Greek text specifies 'τον αδελφον τον ιδιον' (his own brother). The Vietnamese translation omits 'own' (ιδιον), which is a substantive detail regarding the relationship.
